# BCGov Crow - v0.12.6

## Release type

Patch release

## Summary

Dependency maintenance and security reviews now check for explicitly
deprecated libraries and libraries without a published release for at least
one year, including packages that outdated scans report as current. 

## Highlights

- Dependency update plans flag deprecation and potential abandonment using
  registry or maintainer evidence, without treating inactivity alone as a
  confirmed vulnerability.
- Security reviews record dated maintenance signals and unknown status;
  executive summaries can carry those findings into technical-debt reporting.

## Changes

- Added deprecation and last-release checks to the dependency-update
  workflow, security-review guidance and report template, including when no
  newer package version exists.
- Clarified how unattended updates defer replacement decisions and how
  unverified maintenance status is reported.

## Validation

- Crow asset validation: Passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- Package dry run: Passed; 222 files selected.
- Archive inspection: Not run; no release archive has been generated for this draft.
- Additional checks: `git diff --check` passed. Release validation, including
  the local Sonar quality gate, remains pending before approval or publication.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.12.6 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.12.6.zip --global --target copilot
```
